prediction_target.histogram_note: Every current formal-grid row contains one payload support. Calls plus payload therefore reconstruct the complete continuous histogram for this dataset.

predictors.categorical_ridge: Workload, phase, TP, and categorical model identity.
predictors.structure_ridge: Workload, phase, TP, hidden size, layer count, MoE flag, and architecture-derived call/payload drivers.
predictors.analytic_pattern: Known TP operator template: calls=(2*layers+1) per forward; payload=B*tokens*hidden_size*dtype_bytes.
predictors.analytic_residual_mlp: Residual MLP predicts log corrections to analytic calls and payload; it never predicts PatternDemand from scratch.
